definitions.explanation: Trousers that end above the knee, worn for sports, in summer, or by children.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧{短|たん}パン⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{過|す}ごす→過ごす：02062_sugosu⟧。
examples.english: In summer I always wear shorts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{小学生|しょうがくせい}→小学生：03069_shougakusei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ころ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{冬|ふゆ}→冬：00623_fuyu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{短|たん}パン⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{通|かよ}っていた→通う：01217_kayou⟧。
examples.english: When I was in elementary school, I went to school in shorts even in winter.

notes:
From {短|たん} (short) + パン(ツ); casual. Trousers, skirts, and shoes are worn with はく, not ⟦{着|き}る→着る：00541_kiru⟧.

- ⟦ショート→ショート：10951_shooto⟧⟦パンツ→パンツ：01374_pantsu⟧: shorts — the fashion word, often of women's shorts
- ハーフ⟦パンツ→パンツ：01374_pantsu⟧: knee-length shorts
